title: Unity of Leadership in the Family and Its Impact on the Discipline of Children

text_simplified: The text emphasizes the importance of clear leadership within the family and the agreement of adults on guidance, so that children are raised upon *tarbiyah* (upbringing) with obedience and discipline. The difference in directives and their contradiction in front of the children opens the door to many behavioral deviations.
